title: Integration Launch Framework
summary: Manages the launching of integrations and models, handling user interaction, configuration, and model resolution policies. It supports various integration types and ensures a consistent launch experience.

nodes.label: CLI & TUI Management
nodes.title: CLI and TUI Management
nodes.description: Handles command-line interface interactions and Text-based User Interface (TUI) actions for launching and managing integrations and models.

nodes.label: Integration Configuration
nodes.title: Integration Configuration
nodes.description: Manages the configuration of various integrations, including model selection, settings persistence, and validation checks.

nodes.label: Managed Integrations
nodes.title: Managed Integrations
nodes.description: Provides functionality for integrations that have specific management requirements, such as autodiscovery, onboarding, and runtime refreshing.

nodes.label: Model Resolution & Policies
nodes.title: Model Resolution and Launch Policies
nodes.description: Determines which model to launch based on user input, saved configurations, and applies various launch policies (e.g., handling missing models, auto-pull, interactive prompts).

groups.label: User Interaction
groups.title: User Interaction Layer
groups.description: Components responsible for direct user interaction, including command-line arguments and TUI navigation.

groups.label: Configuration & Orchestration
groups.title: Configuration and Orchestration Logic
groups.description: Core logic for managing integration settings, resolving models, and orchestrating the launch process.

groups.label: Integration Management
groups.title: Integration Management
groups.description: Specific logic for managing the lifecycle and behavior of different integration types, including cloud and local integrations.
